key: Mayne, they tryna make the city all nice, but ain't nothin' gonna change the fact that the poor is poor, and the rich is stuck in circlejerk clusterfuck.
en: Mayne, they tryna make the city all nice, but ain't nothin' gonna change the fact that the poor is poor, and the rich is stuck in circlejerk clusterfuck.
ja: マイン、街をきれいにしようとしてるけど、貧乏人は貧乏人のまま、金持ちはくだらない内輪もめに明け暮れてるって現実は何も変わらねえよ。

key: This place is still just a shiny turd.
en: This place is still just a shiny turd.
ja: ここは結局、光り輝くクソだ。

key: We already sent the note. There's no way we won't get a juicy cut from that filthy rich uncle--
en: We already sent the note. There's no way we won't get a juicy cut from that filthy rich uncle--
ja: もう手紙は送った。あの金持ちの薄汚い叔父から、うまい取り分をせしめられないわけがない――

key: Hey, who asked for your opinion?
en: Hey, who asked for your opinion?
ja: おい、誰がお前の意見を求めた?

key: Hey, buzz off! This is a private meeting!
en: Hey, buzz off! This is a private meeting!
ja: おい、失せろ!これは内輪の集まりだ!

key: Unless you wanna pay an extra special entry fee, huh, punk?
en: Unless you wanna pay an extra special entry fee, huh, punk?
ja: 特別な入場料でも払う気があるなら別だがな、坊主?

key: SANTIAGO: What the fuck do you fuckin' want?
en: SANTIAGO: What the fuck do you fuckin' want?
ja: サンティアゴ: てめえ、何の用だクソが?

key: Get the fuck outta here or I'll fuck you the fuck up!
en: Get the fuck outta here or I'll fuck you the fuck up!
ja: さっさと消え失せろ、じゃなきゃぶちのめすぞコラ!

key: What the fuck did you just say to me?
en: What the fuck did you just say to me?
ja: 今なんて言った、てめえ?

key: You got my fuckin' Pokémon you fuckin' punk-ass fuck?
en: You got my fuckin' Pokémon you fuckin' punk-ass fuck?
ja: てめえがおれのクソポケモンを持ってんのか、このクソ野郎が?

key: Come the fuck over here. Let's fuckin' talk, fuckface.
en: Come the fuck over here. Let's fuckin' talk, fuckface.
ja: こっち来い。話そうぜ、クソったれが。

key: SANTIAGO: You got my Jigglypuff dude?
en: SANTIAGO: You got my Jigglypuff dude?
ja: サンティアゴ: てめえ、おれのプリンを持ってんのか?

key: I fuckin' love Jigglypuff dude.
en: I fuckin' love Jigglypuff dude.
ja: マジでプリンが好きなんだよ、クソ。

key: Fuckin' bad-ass Pokémon.
en: Fuckin' bad-ass Pokémon.
ja: クソかっこいいポケモンだからな。

key: But I don't want the other guys to know about that or they'll fuckin' make fun of me...
en: But I don't want the other guys to know about that or they'll fuckin' make fun of me...
ja: でも他の連中には知られたくねえんだ、じゃなきゃからかわれちまうからな……

key: I don't wanna keep you waitin' for fuckin' ever, so you think you could find some other person to give that Jigglypuff to in the fuckin' meantime?
en: I don't wanna keep you waitin' for fuckin' ever, so you think you could find some other person to give that Jigglypuff to in the fuckin' meantime?
ja: クソ待たせたくねえから、その間そのプリンを他の誰かに預けといてくれる奴、見つけてくれねえか?

key: We're fuckin' in the middle of somethin' here, but I'll go get the fuck out of that Jigglypuff dude when we're fuckin' done.
en: We're fuckin' in the middle of somethin' here, but I'll go get the fuck out of that Jigglypuff dude when we're fuckin' done.
ja: 今ちょっと取り込み中だが、終わったらそのプリンをクソ受け取りに行くからよ。

key: Any fuckin' person who wants it will do, just fuckin' come back and tell me where they at.
en: Any fuckin' person who wants it will do, just fuckin' come back and tell me where they at.
ja: 誰でもいいから、預かってくれた場所を戻ってきて教えてくれりゃいい。

key: You fuckin' got that?
en: You fuckin' got that?
ja: わかったか、コラ?

key: Fuck yeah. You're the fuckin' best.
en: Fuck yeah. You're the fuckin' best.
ja: クソ最高だ。お前、マジで最高だぜ。

key: Hey, hold the fuck up though.
en: Hey, hold the fuck up though.
ja: おい、ちょっと待てや。

key: You mind throwin' the fuck down with me real quick?
en: You mind throwin' the fuck down with me real quick?
ja: ちょっとオレと戦ってくれねえか?

key: Gotta make it look like I scrapped you the fuck up, otherwise the other fucks will get suspicious.
en: Gotta make it look like I scrapped you the fuck up, otherwise the other fucks will get suspicious.
ja: お前をぶちのめしたように見せかけねえと、他の連中に怪しまれるからよ。

key: Fuck!
en: Fuck!
ja: くそっ!

key: SANTIAGO: You're the fuckin' man.
en: SANTIAGO: You're the fuckin' man.
ja: サンティアゴ: てめえ、マジで男らしいな。

key: Well, not that you're a--
en: Well, not that you're a--
ja: いや別に、お前が男だとかそういう意味じゃ――

key: You know what I fuckin' mean.
en: You know what I fuckin' mean.
ja: 言いたいことはわかるだろ。

key: I'll be waitin' to hear from you about who's holdin' Jigglypuff dude for me!
en: I'll be waitin' to hear from you about who's holdin' Jigglypuff dude for me!
ja: そのプリンを誰が預かってるか、教えてくれるの待ってるからな!

key: SANTIAGO: What the fuck digs?
en: SANTIAGO: What the fuck digs?
ja: サンティアゴ: おいクソ、どうなった?

key: You figure a place for that Pokémon the fuck out yet?
en: You figure a place for that Pokémon the fuck out yet?
ja: あのポケモンの居場所、突き止めたか?

key: So some fuckin' girl in Jasper's got it?
en: So some fuckin' girl in Jasper's got it?
ja: ジャスパーにいるクソ女が持ってるって?

key: Fuck yeah.
en: Fuck yeah.
ja: クソ最高だ。

key: You're the fuckin' best.
en: You're the fuckin' best.
ja: お前、マジで最高だぜ。

key: You ever need anythin', you fuckin' let me know, you got that?
en: You ever need anythin', you fuckin' let me know, you got that?
ja: 何か必要になったらいつでもクソ言えよ、わかったか?

key: Now fuck outta here.
en: Now fuck outta here.
ja: さっさとクソ失せろ。

key: SANTIAGO: Hey, pal, what the fuck's up?
en: SANTIAGO: Hey, pal, what the fuck's up?
ja: サンティアゴ: よお相棒、どうした?

key: You fuckin' want somethin'?
en: You fuckin' want somethin'?
ja: 何か用でもあんのか?

key: If you fuckin' want somethin', come the fuck over here and let's talk fuckin' business.
en: If you fuckin' want somethin', come the fuck over here and let's talk fuckin' business.
ja: クソ用があるなら、こっち来て話そうぜ。

key: What the fuck do you need? I'll do anythin' in my fuckin' power to help you out, dog.
en: What the fuck do you need? I'll do anythin' in my fuckin' power to help you out, dog.
ja: 何が必要なんだ?クソ手助けできることなら何でもしてやるぜ、相棒。

key: What? You're lookin' for that fuckin' kid?
en: What? You're lookin' for that fuckin' kid?
ja: は?あのクソガキを探してるのか?

key: Yeah, we got the lil' fucker.
en: Yeah, we got the lil' fucker.
ja: ああ、あのクソガキならおれらが預かってるぜ。

key: And don't fuckin' get me wrong.
en: And don't fuckin' get me wrong.
ja: 勘違いすんなよ。

key: I don't fuckin' approve of fuckin' around with kids.
en: I don't fuckin' approve of fuckin' around with kids.
ja: ガキ相手にクソふざけたことすんのは認めてねえからな。

key: That shit's just fuckin' wrong.
en: That shit's just fuckin' wrong.
ja: それはマジでクソ間違ってる。

key: But this situation's a little different.
en: But this situation's a little different.
ja: でも今回の状況はちょっと違うんだ。

key: I mean, it's a little fucked up.
en: I mean, it's a little fucked up.
ja: つうか、ちょっとクソやばいことになっててな。

key: When you get there, you'll see what I fuckin' mean.
en: When you get there, you'll see what I fuckin' mean.
ja: 行きゃクソわかるさ。

key: The lil' fucker's held up on the roof of one of the buildings in the fuckin' Onyx Ward.
en: The lil' fucker's held up on the roof of one of the buildings in the fuckin' Onyx Ward.
ja: あのクソガキはオニキスワードのどっかのビルの屋上に閉じ込めてある。

key: Go fuck 'em up.
en: Go fuck 'em up.
ja: ぶちのめしてこい。

key: SANTIAGO: The lil' fucker's held up on the roof of one of the buildings in the fuckin' Onyx Ward.
en: SANTIAGO: The lil' fucker's held up on the roof of one of the buildings in the fuckin' Onyx Ward.
ja: サンティアゴ: あのクソガキはオニキスワードのどっかのビルの屋上に閉じ込めてある。

key: SANTIAGO: My job fuckin' fell through thanks to you,
en: SANTIAGO: My job fuckin' fell through thanks to you,
ja: サンティアゴ: てめえのせいでクソ仕事がふいになっちまったが、

key: But it was fucked up anyway, so what the fuck.
en: But it was fucked up anyway, so what the fuck.
ja: どうせクソみたいな仕事だったから、まあいいさ。

key: I got my fuckin' Jigglypuff dude, that's all that fuckin' matters.
en: I got my fuckin' Jigglypuff dude, that's all that fuckin' matters.
ja: クソプリンは取り返した、それだけが大事なんだよ。

key: Jigglypuff dude's the fuckin' best.
en: Jigglypuff dude's the fuckin' best.
ja: プリンはクソ最高だぜ。

key: CUEBALL: Back off right now, or it's her life!
en: CUEBALL: Back off right now, or it's her life!
ja: キューボール: 今すぐ下がれ、じゃなきゃこいつの命はないぞ!

key: LASS: P-please--
en: LASS: P-please--
ja: ミニスカート: お、お願い――

key: CUEBALL: Not a word out of you, girl!
en: CUEBALL: Not a word out of you, girl!
ja: キューボール: おい、お前は黙ってろ!

key: You should've cooperated in the first place instead of calling for help!
en: You should've cooperated in the first place instead of calling for help!
ja: 助けを呼んだりしないで、最初から素直に従っておけばよかったんだよ!

key: Whatever happens to you is your own damn fault!
en: Whatever happens to you is your own damn fault!
ja: お前に何が起きようと、それはお前自身のせいだからな!

key: ANNA: Why don't you let us handle this, \PN?
en: ANNA: Why don't you let us handle this, \PN?
ja: アンナ: あたしたちに任せてくれない、\PN?

key: CUEBALL: Haaah!? And just what's a little girl gonna do about it?!
en: CUEBALL: Haaah!? And just what's a little girl gonna do about it?!
ja: キューボール: はぁ?小娘一人に何ができるってんだ?

key: You gonna go tattle on your daddy to me?
en: You gonna go tattle on your daddy to me?
ja: パパにでも言いつけるつもりか?

key: ANNA: You know, you might wanna look behind you.
en: ANNA: You know, you might wanna look behind you.
ja: アンナ: ねえ、後ろを見た方がいいかもよ。

key: CUEBALL: Hah, yeah, right!
en: CUEBALL: Hah, yeah, right!
ja: キューボール: はっ、そりゃないぜ!

key: I know better than to fall for that one!
en: I know better than to fall for that one!
ja: その手には引っかからねえよ!

key: Second I look away, you're gonna try somethin'!
en: Second I look away, you're gonna try somethin'!
ja: 目を離した瞬間に何かしてくるつもりだろ!

key: ANNA: I don't need you to look away for me to be able to do that.
en: ANNA: I don't need you to look away for me to be able to do that.
ja: アンナ: あんたが目を離さなくても、あたしはやれることをやれるの。

key: I just thought you'd want to say "Hi" to my friend over your shoulder there.
en: I just thought you'd want to say "Hi" to my friend over your shoulder there.
ja: ただ、あんたの肩越しにいるあたしの友達に「こんにちは」って言ってほしかっただけ。

key: CUEBALL: ...Huh?
en: CUEBALL: ...Huh?
ja: キューボール: ……は?

key: SHADE: ...Boo.
en: SHADE: ...Boo.
ja: シェイド: ……ボー。

key: CUEBALL: W-what the hell--
en: CUEBALL: W-what the hell--
ja: キューボール: な、なんだこりゃ――

key: LASS: A-ah, thank you!
en: LASS: A-ah, thank you!
ja: ミニスカート: あ、ああ、ありがとう!

key: Who-- who are you...?
en: Who-- who are you...?
ja: あなた……あなたたちは……?

key: ANNA: You can just think of me as this region's guardian angel.
en: ANNA: You can just think of me as this region's guardian angel.
ja: アンナ: あたしはこの地方の守護天使だと思ってくれればいいわ。

key: In the name of shimmering justice, I'll protect everyone!
en: In the name of shimmering justice, I'll protect everyone!
ja: 輝ける正義の名のもとに、みんなを守ってみせる!

key: Now let's get you home.
en: Now let's get you home.
ja: さあ、あなたを家まで送りましょう。

key: LASS: ...What's going to happen to him?
en: LASS: ...What's going to happen to him?
ja: ミニスカート: ……あの人はこれからどうなるの?

key: ANNA: We'll make sure he'll never bother you again~
en: ANNA: We'll make sure he'll never bother you again~
ja: アンナ: あいつが二度とあなたを煩わせないように、あたしたちがちゃんとするから。

key: LASS: He seemed like a pretty desperate kid...
en: LASS: He seemed like a pretty desperate kid...
ja: ミニスカート: あの子、すごく追い詰められてるみたいだったわ……

key: ANNA: Maybe!
en: ANNA: Maybe!
ja: アンナ: かもね!

key: But that doesn't mean we can let it go.
en: But that doesn't mean we can let it go.
ja: でも、だからといって見逃していい理由にはならない。

key: You can take it from here, right, \PN?
en: You can take it from here, right, \PN?
ja: ここからはあんたに任せていいよね、\PN?

key: LASS: Th-thank you all...
en: LASS: Th-thank you all...
ja: ミニスカート: み、みんな、ありがとう……

key: SHADE: ...
en: SHADE: ...
ja: シェイド: ……

key: SHADE: ...The girl's taken wing. This was foretold.
en: SHADE: ...The girl's taken wing. This was foretold.
ja: シェイド: ……あの娘は羽ばたいた。これは予見されていたこと。

key: Yet her power is tempered; her resistance, controlled.
en: Yet her power is tempered; her resistance, controlled.
ja: されどその力は制御され、その抵抗もまた抑えられている。

key: It was your hand that did it-- your mercy, your grace.
en: It was your hand that did it-- your mercy, your grace.
ja: それを成したのはお前の手――お前の慈悲、お前の恵み。

key: For guiding lost children, you have heartfelt thanks.
en: For guiding lost children, you have heartfelt thanks.
ja: 迷える子らを導いた者よ、心よりの感謝を。

key: We stay to watch over-- that she does no wrong.
en: We stay to watch over-- that she does no wrong.
ja: 我らはここに留まり見守ろう――彼女が過ちを犯さぬように。

key: This arrangement is fleeting; our time's come and gone.
en: This arrangement is fleeting; our time's come and gone.
ja: この取り決めもまたはかきもの。我らの時も、もはや過ぎ去ろうとしている。

key: The chapter is ending-- you know this, dear reader.
en: The chapter is ending-- you know this, dear reader.
ja: この章は終わりを迎える――読み手よ、お前はそれを知っている。

key: We all must move forward.
en: We all must move forward.
ja: 我らは皆、前へ進まねばならない。

key: That's your charge as leader.
en: That's your charge as leader.
ja: それがお前の、指導者としての務めだ。
